title: Preserved wip snapshots are invisible across run ids, exactly as reports were
description:
priorSnapshots walks the same <ExecStateRoot>/<runID>/<tick>/<n> layout that report discovery used before n4h, so a re-run under a NEW run id is never pointed at a previous run's preserved wip refs. Work that was deliberately snapshotted to survive a teardown is then invisible to the attempt most likely to need it.

n4h already solved this shape once, for reports: the same cross-run walk, the same tick-keyed record check (a wip snapshot beside an attempt.json naming the tick). This is that fix applied to WORK instead of analysis, so the design is proven rather than speculative.

discovered_from run-epic-9pd/tick-n4h/attempt-32
acceptance_criteria: An attempt dispatched under a new run id is offered the wip snapshots preserved by previous runs of the same tick, discovered the same way n4h discovers prior reports. A test covers a snapshot made under one run id and found under another.
